answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The reef of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The sparrow holds work receipts rather than names, so the relic of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short.
